results.title: Gurgaon schools shift online, offices adopt WFH today amid heavy rainfall, waterlogging and traffic disruption
results.description: Gurugram schools have shifted to online classes today, August 25, 2026, while corporate and private offices have been advised to operate under Work From Home arrangements following heavy rainfall. The DDMA issued the advisory after around 75 mm of rain caused widespread waterlogging, stranded school buses and severe traffic disruption across key roads. The IMD has issued an orange alert, while civic teams are carrying out pumping, drainage and road maintenance work.

results.title: Nifty Intraday Outlook for 25-08-2026
results.description: 📊 NIFTY 15-Min: Gap-Down Expected Near Critical Support NIFTY closed near 24,220 after recovering strongly from the 24,150 support zone. However, GIFT Nifty indicates a weaker opening near 24,150, which may bring price directly back toward this important support. That makes 24,150 the key breakdown level for today's session. ------------------------------------ 📌 Important Levels Resistance: • 24,230 Upside Targets: • 24,315 • 24,360 • 24,420 Support: • 24,145 Downside Targets: • 24,100 • 24,030 • 23,950 ------------------------------------ 📉 Bearish Plan If NIFTY breaks and sustains below 24,145: • PE after bearish confirmation • Prefer breakdown + failed reclaim • Targets: 24,100 / 24,030 / 23,950 A rejection from 24,220–24,250 can also provide a cleaner sell-on-rise setup. Do not chase PE if the market opens directly near support and prints an extended red candle. ------------------------------------ 📈 **Bullish Plan** CE only after NIFTY reclaims and sustains above 24,230. Targets: • 24,270 • 24,300 • 24,360 Above 24,315, the recovery structure becomes considerably stronger. If the gap-down holds above 24,150 and price quickly reclaims 24,180–24,200, short covering can develop toward resistance. ------------------------------------ 🌍 Market Context GIFT Nifty indicates a mildly negative opening ahead of the NIFTY monthly derivatives expiry. Asian markets are also trading weak, while Brent crude remains elevated near $92. Iran has threatened retaliation after new US sanctions, and Strait of Hormuz shipping activity remains sharply below normal levels. These factors may keep expiry-day volatility elevated. ------------------------------------ ✅ Final View Above 24,230 → recovery strengthens Below 24,145 → bearish continuation Below 24,030 → downside momentum can accelerate Hold 24,145 after gap-down → short-covering bounce possible Inside 24,160–24,220 → WAIT Educational analysis only. Trade with confirmation and disciplined risk management.
